stories.title: Set a repository up for spec-driven development

evidence.summary: landed in phase 1, release 0.1.12; /sdd-init set this repository's spec set up (a854af2) and it checks; cw test 5 cases, the spec format coming up on the spec files; doctor passes here; in a clone with no spec set it asked each question of the manifest with its recommendation and wrote nothing before the yes

stories.title: Plan a phase into stories

evidence.summary: /sdd-plan wrote CORE Stories 1–11 here (a854af2, and CORE Story 11 from CORE Story 9's pass), each Todo with its dependencies, and /sdd-analyze ran in its check step; in a clone it named an FR no story cites as an error with its fix and changed nothing; in a clone /sdd-plan paused at each step, asked three questions one at a time and drafted CORE Story 19, Todo, with its dependency

stories.title: See where the roadmap stands

evidence.summary: node --test: sdd-specs 37 pass, 0 fail; cw test: Stop runs sdd-specs-on-stop; run here: link linked CORE Stories 12–18's citations, check passes, ready lists CORE Stories 11 and 21, report wrote the roadmap; in clones a stop with a status line set to Finished was handed back and the agent set it right, and /sdd-status listed every story with its status, the counts and what is ready

stories.title: Implement a story from pick to Done

evidence.summary: /sdd-implement walked CORE Stories 1–10 here, and CORE Story 11 to its hand-over: pick, spec gate before any change, tests first, verify and review, Done once accepted, CORE Story 11's pipe test failing at 65536 bytes before clean.mjs changed; in a clone with notes ignored it started CORE Story 11 from the story and its branch

stories.title: Fix a bug on a branch of its own

evidence.summary: by hand in a clone: /sdd-bug-fix on a fix branch from develop reproduced a ready bug, waited for approval of root cause and fix, fixed it with tests that failed before the fix (ready excludes a Done story with no dependency), named the baseline's known failure at the hand-over, and landed in develop, the phase branch unchanged

stories.title: Land the work the way the manifest says

evidence.summary: /sdd-finish squash-merged CORE Stories 1–10 into the phase branch and deleted each branch here; in clones a fix landed in develop, a manifest with no Story line made /sdd-finish ask how the story lands, landing nothing, and cleanup listed one landed branch of three and deleted only it once confirmed

stories.title: Keep what a session learned

evidence.summary: learning/inbox notes written by /sdd-learn here turned into rules (f94fa66); cw test: sdd-learnings-go-to-the-inbox comes up every turn

stories.title: Review by an agent that did not write the change

evidence.summary: by hand on CORE Story 9: a review agent spawned with only the story id, the diff path and the verify line gathered the story, FR, SC and guides itself and graded each finding bug, risk, nit or q, failing on the bug and risks

stories.title: Check the baseline before the first change

evidence.summary: by hand in a clone with one test broken: the baseline stopped before any change, quoted not ok 36, offered /sdd-bug-fix or known; recorded as known, verify passed naming it known, and the hand-over named it

stories.title: Hand a story in progress over to the next session

evidence.summary: node --test: 51 pass, 0 fail; by hand in clones: a new session read the handoff note before acting on the story, resumed at its Remaining step and asked nothing it answers; /sdd-init asked Handoff notes and wrote it; check fails a note for a Done story

stories.title: Refuse to finish on an unclean state

evidence.summary: node --test: sdd-clean 17 pass, 0 fail, a clean state run twice passing with the same result; by hand in a clone: /sdd-finish on a Done story holding a temporary file and a debug print named each finding and landed nothing, the phase branch unchanged

stories.title: Keep the proof that a story works

evidence.summary: node --test: 35 pass, 0 fail; cw test 4 cases; check accepts evidence on a Done story, refuses it on one not Done, and --landing refuses a story with none

stories.title: Read the runtime while verifying

evidence.summary: node --test: 35 pass, 0 fail; cw test 4 cases; a manual run exiting 0 with an error on stderr fails on the quoted line, a silent run is said to log nothing

stories.title: Check the product against its stories over time

evidence.summary: node --test: 52 pass, 0 fail; by hand in clones: /sdd-quality, in a cross-check waiting on CORE alone, wrote the missing quality.md from its template, checked the code and every spec, BILLING included, item by item, failed each violation by path:line, graded F, handed the violations to /sdd-plan, fixed nothing and held the story from Done; a second pass put its report in place of the older one under Last pass, the checklist unchanged; /sdd-init wrote quality.md as the checklist; /sdd-plan added cross-checks after every five, or the manifest's number, carrying the leftovers

stories.title: Check the spec-driven setup itself

evidence.summary: node --test: 50 pass, 0 fail; cw test 5 cases; doctor passes settings, spec folder and manifest here; in a clone it failed a manifest missing Handoff notes with that one /sdd-init question as its fix, passed once it was answered, and said a repository with no settings is not set up, offering /sdd-init

stories.title: Review with the proof verify produced

evidence.summary: node --test: 35 pass, 0 fail; cw test 4 cases; a failing verify stopped the review with the tree unchanged; a reviewer handed a verify line naming no hand run failed the unproven scenario; CORE Story 11's review counted scenario 6, which no test holds, proven by the clone run its verify line named

stories.title: Quality cross-check of CORE Stories 1–8 and 10

evidence.summary: node --test: 52 pass, 0 fail, twice; cw test 5 cases; by hand in clones: the quality pass checked the code and every spec against the checklist /sdd-init writes, graded once, put its report under Last pass in place of the older one, and handed its violations to /sdd-plan, now CORE Story 11; doctor named the /sdd-init question for each missing field

stories.title: Fix what the first quality pass found

evidence.summary: node --test: sdd-specs 37 and sdd-clean 17 pass, 0 fail (one unnamed sdd-clean failure in 62 runs, never again in 61); cw test 6 cases; sdd-clean pipes 6000 findings whole (65536 bytes before); in clones: quality pass graded A, a Vietnamese /sdd-bug-fix answered in Vietnamese and ended its hand-over on the set line, implement with notes ignored started from the story and its branch

stories.title: Answer in the user's language after a slash command, and propose before asking

evidence.summary: node --test: sdd-specs 37, sdd-clean 17 pass, 0 fail; cw test 6 cases, sdd-voice always on; in clones on opus: slash commands with Vietnamese words reported in Vietnamese, questions gave their case and a proposal, a full /sdd-implement walk and a /sdd-bug-fix said nothing of passing steps and ended on approve ?; the review agent built with model opus

stories.title: Choose how strict the review is

evidence.summary: node --test: sdd-specs 40 (doctor fails a manifest with no Review; a fix's note fix-<slug>.md left alone; a FIX spec's note still checked), sdd-clean 17, 0 fail; in clones on opus: /sdd-doctor asked Review; quick bug fix kept its note and its nits in it, handing over approve ? alone; two quick walks settled a small q into the note; a q to ask held by the text alone

stories.title: Keep the handoff note once the story is Done

evidence.summary: node --test: sdd-specs 41 (a Done story's note passes check and check --landing, ignored or not; a Todo story's still fails), sdd-clean 17, 0 fail; in clones on opus: /sdd-finish landed a Done story with its note in the commit, and a /sdd-bug-fix landed in develop with its fix note

stories.title: Put the charter's promises to the real agent

evidence.summary: Node tests 58/58; cw test 6/6; doctor, spec, clean and diff checks passed; all 20 real-agent cases have passing evidence across full runs and focused retries, including both voice cases after fixing status order and both engine commands; independent Codex review passed under the user's one-story Opus exception

stories.title: Find the code smells of a repository

evidence.summary: node --test 87 pass, 0 fail, twice; cw test 6 cases; cw doctor, check, clean and diff checks pass; real agent runs on Sonnet in scratch repositories: rules not on code dropped with why, a bad file recorded with its finding and a good one good, files left out with why, no code changed, a new charter assessed 0 and no rescan, a rescan asked in words assessed all, a run killed after 2 files resumed with the other 4, hostile file names ran no command, an agent asked in plain words never started it

stories.title: Review the code smells and plan the refactoring

evidence.summary: Source/generated suites 200/200; fresh landing generated suite 100/100; charter cases 6/6; doctor/spec checks pass; manual scan, review, id skip/agree with reasons and planning/splitting workflows pass; independent review passed.

stories.title: See the code smells in the roadmap report

evidence.summary: node --test 105 pass, 0 fail; cw test 6 cases; cw doctor nothing to fix; check exit 0; report run by hand with no record, a record, an unreadable record and a finding with its own path: the roadmap drawn, the section saying what the record holds or why not
